lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Non-uniform grid of high-luminance circular clusters on the lateral flank, with a higher density of smaller spots towards the anterior and larger, more spaced spots towards the mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Intermittent vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of spots to form a visible lattice structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: One distinct horizontal ridge running along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to low luminance shadow on the ventral side.
